_comment: Which figures build up click by click, and what arrives on each click. Bands are in figure units - 10 to the inch, origin bottom left, so the whole canvas is 0..124 x 0..44.5, the same numbers fig_methods.py and plot_bioasq.py lay out in. Run `python3 slides/hgf_layers.py` for the click count per figure.
_how: 'split_x': [a, b] cuts the full canvas into bands at those x positions. 'rects': [[x0,y0,x1,y1], ...] declares them outright, which is what to use when the bands should NOT reach the figure's heading or its grey scope line - anything outside every band is furniture and stays on screen for every click. 'groups': [[0,1],[2]] makes bands arrive together; the default is one band per click.
_absent: A figure with no entry here gets no layers and no animation. selective_generation is one plate with three overlapping curves, so there is nothing to reveal in sequence; it is left alone deliberately rather than forgotten.

confidently_wrong._: Four example rows, one per click. Bands stop below the column headers at y 40.9 and above the footnote, so both stay on screen throughout.

dataset._: The example question first, then the sample, then the grading table. The left panel's ground is inside its own band, so it arrives with its words.

limitations._: The top row of three cards, then the bottom row.

uq_types._: Five signal-type columns, 22.88 u wide on a 2.4 u gap. Cut at the gap midpoints.

information_based._: How it works, then the methods table.

lm_polygraph._: The four pipeline stages left to right, then the two notes underneath. Bands are contiguous so each arrow arrives with the stage it leaves.

types_by_tier._: One tier column per click. The row labels at x 0..23 are outside every band, so the five signal types are the scaffold and the tiers fill in.

auroc_by_method._: Ranks 1-10, then 11-20. Bands stop short of the heading at y 42 and the scope line at y 2.

auroc_by_tier._: Tier 1 alone, then tiers 2-4 together - which is the figure's claim. Four separate bands would leave the CHANCE label, which sits past the last column, arriving on its own.

uncertainty_by_correctness._: The tier-1 method, then the tier-4 one beside it.

model_size_comparison._: The scatter, then the reading panel on the right.
